title: 第14章 少主把人砍啦！
content_zh:
第14章少主把人砍啦！
一夜无话。
清晨，夜惊堂靠在墙角，注意外面的风吹草动。
鸟鸟蹲在怀里，可能是有外人的缘故，睡向稍微正常了些，只是歪着头。
骆女侠看起来没深睡，每隔一刻钟，就会作势翻身，偷偷瞄他这边一眼，估计在看他有没有对折云璃动手动脚。
折云璃倒是安分，靠在三尺远的地方，抱着刀纹丝不动，半夜也没出现靠在肩膀上的情况。
东方逐渐发白。
夜惊堂看到点了，就抱着鸟鸟起身，哪想到这一动，旁边的姑娘，就刀出半寸，戒备望向他。
“你做什么？”
“出去干活儿。”
夜惊堂拍了拍袍子，示意房间：
“你以为我和你们这些高门大派出来的人一样，什么都不干，就有吃有喝？”
折云璃眨了眨眼睛，收起刀，起身拍了拍挺翘的屁股：
“你干什么活儿？要不要帮忙？”
床铺上的骆凝，闻言撑起上半身，带着三分困倦：
“云璃！”
休息一夜，骆凝气色恢复大半，原本的姿容也开始展现，如慵懒少妇般撑起身体，水波般的长发洒下，那双困倦又带着薄怒的桃花美眸，足以让昏睡的人瞬间清醒、让清醒的人陷入迷离。
夜惊堂昨天就觉得骆凝姿容不凡，早上再一看，直接又多了三分仙气，说是被牛郎骗回家的仙女丝毫不为过，不免多看了几眼。
发现夜惊堂打量，骆凝倒头就躺下了，把被褥拉了起来遮住身体，眼神微冷。
折云璃见骆凝阻难，笑嘻嘻回应：

“师娘，我不是出去玩，是打探消息，跟着他要安全些。”
夜惊堂提着刀出门：“你倒是安全了，我怎么办？我可不是你们同伙，万一你们把黑衙六煞引来，我打也不是跑也不是，岂不把我连累了？”
“我装作你媳妇，应该没人……”
“云璃！”
骆凝一头翻起来，怒火中烧！
折云璃无奈道：“逢场作戏嘛……”
“什么逢场作戏？”
骆凝听见这词儿就来气，让云璃装作这小贼的媳妇，铁定被顺水推舟占便宜，她都已经……
那不成师徒同侍一夫了……
“你一个未出阁的姑娘家，岂能做这种戏？”
折云璃想想也是：“那我装他妹子……诶？”
还没说完，夜惊堂已经消失在了院门外……
另一侧，天水桥，裴家大宅。
天色刚亮，裴湘君在正厅就坐，手指轻敲桌案，眉头紧锁。
主位上，坐着裴家老大的遗孀张玉莲张夫人，眉宇间也带有愁色，手里端着白瓷茶盏，用杯盖轻轻摩擦着杯沿：
“外面的江湖人，越来越不讲情面，王香主去周家拜访，谈谈清江码头的事儿，连几位当家都没见到，就让管家出面接待……咱们青龙堂沦落到这步田地，还有什么脸面号令红花楼各大堂主……”
“大嫂，这些事我岂会不知，江湖上说话看拳头……”
张夫人在江湖上的职位，算是‘帮主夫人’，如今裴家老大老二都过世了，只剩下儿子裴洛；裴洛没啥习武天赋，又是独苗，她也不敢把江湖产业告诉儿子，如今除了指望面前的三娘，还能指望谁？
张夫人知道裴湘君独自扛起红花楼不容易，轻叹道：
“三娘，我没说你，是说形势。现如今，只能指望二弟送来的惊堂，能扛起这些事儿。二弟过世，惊堂都能遵循遗嘱，千里迢迢把家产送来，必然重情义，品行不会差。要不你传惊堂枪法，让他……”

裴湘君微微摇头：“我知道惊堂品行端正，长得也是一表人才，像干大事儿的人。但远水救不了近火，月棍年刀一辈子枪，他就算底子打好了，天赋不错，把枪法练好，最快也得三五年，出去实战积累名望，又是三年……”
张夫人根本没其他指望，只能道：
“兴许惊堂天赋惊人，个把月就学会了裴家枪，下个月要去聚义楼会见各大堂主，刚好把惊堂带着……”
裴湘君有些无奈：“这样拔苗助长，再好的胚子也得用废。惊堂就算一个月把枪法学会，没半点江湖经验，出去又能打的过谁？”
“楼主，不好了……”
两个女人正交谈之际，门外忽然响起脚步，秀荷跑了进来，满眼焦急。
此言一出，厅中两个女人都是皱眉，裴湘君起身道：
“怎么回事？”
“少主今天过来，路上不知怎么就和六煞起了冲突。”
“六煞？”
裴湘君眉头一皱，略微思索：
“肯定是在鸣玉楼附近亮刀，被黑衙怀疑了，黑衙昨天就派人过来确认过惊堂的身份。惊堂不会《八步狂刀》，让他们随便试，不会出岔子。”
秀荷连忙摇头：“不是不是。黑白无常出的手，附近没眼线，只听说铁臂无常出来时，左臂血流如注……”
“啊？！”
张玉莲站起身，难以置信道：“惊堂把黑无常砍了？”
裴湘君连忙摇头：“开什么玩笑？惊堂不通半点章法，拿什么砍黑无常的铜皮铁骨？那可是黑衙的外家宗师！”
秀荷紧张道：“外面人这么说的，您快去看看，少主好像还被白无常堵着……”
裴湘君见此，也不敢再耽搁，连忙出了门……
黑云压城，天亮了已经有一会儿，街上依旧比较暗淡。
夜惊堂牵马离开双桂巷，和鸟鸟来到天水桥附近，在街口的包子铺点了一笼包子，和鸟鸟一起吃个早饭，心中还在琢磨屋里俩女人吃啥，要不要让鸟鸟送俩包子回去。

但还没琢磨好，夜惊堂眼角余光，就发现不远处的巷子口，有一道人影望向了他。
夜惊堂抬眼打量，却见巷口的人，是昨天刚打过一顿的杨冠。
杨冠手上裹着绷带，脸色阴沉，冲他勾了勾手，然后进入了巷子。
夜惊堂察觉到了不对劲儿，微微抬手，鸟鸟就展翅而起，飞上了高空。
片刻后，鸟鸟从高空落下，“叽叽叽”，示意三个人。
杨冠又冒出来，属于事儿没摆平。
夜惊堂稍微琢磨，丢下几枚铜钱，手按腰刀进入了巷子。
巷道很深，待走到转角，便是一个死胡同，左右皆是高墙，中间一条过道。
阴沉沉的天下色，两道人影并肩站在巷道中央，皆身披蓑衣、头戴斗笠，做寻常江湖人打扮，一个身材高大，一个较为清瘦，没有持兵刃。
杨冠则站在两人背后。
夜惊堂单人一刀站在巷口，打量两个斗笠客一眼后，望向杨冠：
“不服？”
杨冠底气很足：“初来乍到，便敢在京城仗着武艺撒野，你真当世上没人能治你？你自己卸一手一脚，我便放你一马，不然今天把你活活打死，你一个裴家义子，也没人给你出头。”
夜惊堂不再多言，握着刀缓步往前走去，踏出不过两步，身形就猛然爆发，冲向两名斗笠客。
夜惊堂气势很足，但他做梦都不会想到，一个街头收保护费的黑铁泼皮，弄来了俩啥段位的打手！
刀锋刚刚出鞘，两名斗笠客中的高大身影，就微抬斗笠，露出线条刚硬的脸庞，继而身形一闪就到了近前。
夜惊堂察觉不对，一刀往斗笠客劈去，不曾想斗笠客直接抬起右臂格挡。
金铁交击的脆响。
夜惊堂本以为这斗笠客带着护腕铁环，但劈烂袖袍后，才愕然发现，衣服下面就是古铜色的皮肤。
小臂肌肉虬结，除开一道白痕，竟然连皮都没破！

夜惊堂眼神错愕，一瞬间还以为自己看花眼了。
双方搏杀，显然没交流的机会。
高大身影右臂挡住长刀，左手就是一拳递出，直击夜惊堂胸口。
这一拳挺重，但夜惊堂不会上乘招式，底子可是被义父夯实了。
说简单点就是攻击力不行，但抗击打能力并无瑕疵。
胸口中一拳，夜惊堂硬是没啥反应，以刀锋插入地面，往后滑出几步，就稳住了身形。
但刚停步，一阵阴风便从前方吹来，撩起了耳边的发丝。
夜惊堂心中一寒，当即后仰躲避。
下一刻，一道鬼魅身影就从上方掠过，看起来好似一件儿被风吹来的蓑衣，没有实体。
但一张阴历的脸庞，却真真实实出现在斗笠下，冷冷望着他，身体随风而动，好像没半根骨头。
夜惊堂一刀扫向鬼影，却发现刀锋触及蓑衣，蓑衣随刀而走，没有半分着力感。
一刀扫过，没伤及鬼影分毫，他右臂反倒是被蹭了下。
‘鬼拍肩’的力道很轻，以至于夜惊堂感觉是被衣袍剐蹭。
但马上肩头就陷入酸麻，阴寒透体而入，右臂当即力道大减。
夜惊堂心神微震，翻身而起长刀归鞘，左手反握刀柄，背对围墙，余光同时锁住左右两道身影。
轻飘飘的鬼影，已经无声无息堵在唯一出口，斗笠微低纹丝不动，好似一根木头。
高大身形亦是如此。
虽然都没动作，却能感受到寂静巷道中无形的压迫力，就好似巷道左右，耸立着两座山岳……
content_en:
Chapter 14 The young master killed someone!
A night of silence.
In the early morning, Ye Jingtang leaned against the wall and paid attention to the disturbance outside.
Niaoniao squatted in his arms, maybe because of the presence of outsiders, his sleeping position was slightly normal, but he just tilted his head.
Luo Nuxia didn't seem to be in a deep sleep. Every quarter of an hour, she would turn over and secretly glance at him, probably to see if he had touched Zhe Yunli.
Zhe Yunli was calm, leaning three feet away, holding the knife without moving at all, and did not lean on his shoulder in the middle of the night.
The east is gradually whitening.
When Ye Jingtang saw the point, he stood up with Niaoniao in his arms. Unexpectedly, the girl next to him drew his sword half an inch out and looked at him warily.
"What do you do?"
"Go out and do some work."
Ye Jingtang patted his robe and motioned to the room:
"Do you think I'm just like you people from high-ranking sects, doing nothing but eating and drinking?"
Zhe Yunli blinked, put away the knife, stood up and patted his perky butt:
"What do you do? Do you want help?"
Luo Ning, who was on the bed, propped up her upper body after hearing the words, feeling sleepy:
"Yunli!"
After a night's rest, Luo Ning regained most of her complexion, and her original appearance began to show. She propped up her body like a lazy young woman, her long hair flowing like waves, and her sleepy and angry peach blossom eyes, which were enough to wake up a comatose person in an instant and make an awake person fall into confusion.
Yesterday, Ye Jing Tang felt that Luo Ning's appearance was extraordinary. When he looked at her again in the morning, he felt that she was even more fairy-like. It was not an exaggeration to say that she was a fairy who was deceived by the Cowherd into returning home, so she couldn't help but take a few more glances.
Seeing that Ye Jingtang was looking at her, Luo Ning lay down and pulled up the quilt to cover her body, her eyes slightly cold.
Seeing Luo Ning's difficulty, Zhe Yunli responded with a smile:
"Master Wife, I'm not going out to play, I'm just looking for information. It's safer to follow him."
Ye Jingtang went out with a knife: "You are safe, what should I do? I am not your accomplice. If you attract the six evil spirits of Heiya, I can neither fight nor run. Wouldn't it involve me?"
"I'm pretending to be your wife, there should be no one..."
"Yunli!"
Luo Ning turned around and was furious!
Zhe Yunli said helplessly: "It's just a joke..."
"What's the joke?"
Luo Ning got angry when she heard these words, and asked Yunli to pretend to be the wife of this little thief. She would definitely be taken advantage of, and she had already...
Then it’s not like master and disciple serve the same husband at the same time...
"How can you, a girl who has not left the court, do such a show?"
Zhe Yunli thought about it and said, "Then I pretend to be his sister...eh?"
Before he finished speaking, Ye Jingtang had already disappeared outside the courtyard gate...
On the other side, Tianshui Bridge, the Pei family mansion.
It was just dawn, and Pei Xiangjun was sitting in the main hall, tapping the table with his fingers and frowning.
On the main seat, Mrs. Zhang Yulian, the widow of the eldest member of the Pei family, sat, with a sad look on her eyebrows. She held a white porcelain tea cup in her hand and gently rubbed the rim of the cup with the lid:
"The Jianghu people outside are becoming more and more unkind. Master Wang Xiang went to the Zhou family to visit and talk about the Qingjiang Wharf. He didn't even see the heads of the house, so he asked the housekeeper to come out to receive him... Our Qinglong Hall has fallen into this situation, how can we still have the dignity to order the hall masters of Honghua Building..."
"Sister-in-law, how could I not know these things? In the world of martial arts, it depends on your fists..."
Mrs. Zhang's position in Jianghu is regarded as the 'Mrs. of the Gang Leader'. Now that the eldest and second son of the Pei family have passed away, only her son Pei Luo is left. Pei Luo has no talent for martial arts and is an only child. She does not dare to tell her son about the Jianghu industry. Who else can she count on now besides the Sanniang in front of her?
Mrs. Zhang knew that it was not easy for Pei Xiangjun to carry Honghua Tower alone, so she sighed softly:
"Sanniang, I'm not talking about you, I'm talking about the situation. Nowadays, we can only count on Jingtang, who is sent by the second brother, to be able to handle these things. When the second brother passes away, Jingtang can follow his will and send the family property all the way, so he must value friendship and have good conduct.How about you teach him the Jingtang marksmanship and let him..."
Pei Xiangjun shook his head slightly: "I know that Jingtang has good conduct and looks like a person who does big things. But water from a distance can't save a fire from a distance. A stick, a stick, a sword, and a gun will last a lifetime. Even if he has a good foundation, good talent, and good marksmanship, it will take him three to five years at the fastest. Going out to practice and accumulate fame will take another three years..."
Mrs. Zhang had no other hope at all and could only say:
"Perhaps Jingtang's talent is amazing. He learned the Pei family's gun within a few months. Next month, he will go to Juyi Building to meet with the major hall masters, so he just happened to take Jingtang with him..."
Pei Xiangjun was a little helpless: "In this way, the best embryos will be wasted. Even if Jingtang learns marksmanship in a month, without any experience in martial arts, who can he beat when he goes out? "
"Lord, it's not good..."
While the two women were talking, footsteps suddenly sounded outside the door, and Xiuhe ran in, eyes full of anxiety.
As soon as these words came out, the two women in the hall frowned. Pei Xiangjun stood up and said:
"What's going on? "
"Young Master came here today, and for some reason he had a conflict with Liu Sha on the way. "
"Six evil spirits? "
Pei Xiangjun frowned and thought for a moment:
"He must have flashed his sword near Mingyu Tower, and was suspected by the Hei Yamen. The Hei Yamen sent someone over yesterday to confirm Jingtang's identity. Jingtang doesn't know "Eight-Step Crazy Sword", let them try it casually, nothing will go wrong. "
Xiuhe quickly shook his head: "No, no. There was no eyeliner near the hand that Black and White Wuchang came out with. I only heard that when Iron Arm Wuchang came out, his left arm was bleeding profusely..."
"Huh? ! "
Zhang Yulian stood up and said in disbelief: "Jingtang chopped down Hei Wuchang? "
Pei Xiangjun shook his head quickly: "Are you kidding me? If you don't understand the rules at all, how can you chop down the black and impermanent copper skin and iron bones? That's the grandmaster of Heiya's family! "
Xiuhe said nervously: "That's what people outside said. Go and take a look. The young master seems to be blocked by Bai Wuchang..."
Seeing this, Pei Xiangjun didn't dare to delay any longer and hurried out...
Dark clouds were over the city, it had been dawn for a while, and the streets were still relatively dark.
Ye Jingtang left Shuanggui Lane with his horse, and went to Tianshui Bridge with Niaoniao. He ordered a basket of buns from the bun shop at the corner of the street, and had breakfast with Niaoniao. He was still thinking about what the two women in the house would eat, and whether Niaoniao should send the two buns home.
But before he could figure it out, out of the corner of his eye, Ye Jingtang spotted a figure looking at him from the entrance of the alley not far away.
Ye Jingtang looked up and saw that the person at the entrance of the alley was Yang Guan, who had just been beaten yesterday.
Yang Guan's hands were wrapped in bandages and his face was gloomy. He hooked his hand and entered the alley.
Ye Jingtang noticed something was wrong, raised his hand slightly, and the bird spread its wings and flew high into the sky.
After a while, the bird fell from the sky, "chichichichi", signaling to the three people.
Yang Guan showed up again, it was because the matter was not settled.
Ye Jingtang thought about it for a while, threw down a few coins, held the knife in his hand and entered the alley.
The alleyway is very deep. When you reach the corner, you will reach a dead end with high walls on the left and right and an aisle in the middle.
In a gloomy world, two figures stood side by side in the middle of the alley. Both were wearing raincoats and bamboo hats, dressed as ordinary people in the world. One was tall, the other was thin, and did not hold a weapon.
Yang Guan stood behind the two of them.
Ye Jingtang stood alone at the entrance of the alley, looked at the two men in bamboo hats, and then looked at Yang Guan:
"Not convinced? "
Yang Guan was very confident: "When you first arrived, you dared to go wild in the capital with your martial arts skills. Do you really think that no one in the world can control you? If you take off your hands and feet, I will let you go, otherwise I will beat you to death today. You are the adopted son of the Pei family, and no one will stand up for you. "
Ye Jingtang stopped talking and walked forward slowly with the knife in hand. After taking only two steps, his body suddenly erupted and rushed towards the two men in bamboo hats.
The Night Terror Hall was very impressive, but he would never have imagined that a gangster collecting protection money on the street could get two things.Ranked fighter!
As soon as the blade was unsheathed, the tall figure among the two haters raised his hat slightly, revealing a face with strong lines, and then he came closer in a flash.
Ye Jingtang sensed something was wrong and struck at the man in the hat with his knife. Unexpectedly, the man in the hat raised his right arm to block.
The crisp sound of gold and iron clashing.
Ye Jingtang originally thought that the man in the hat was wearing wrist guards and iron rings, but after splitting the sleeves of the robe, he was shocked to find that underneath the clothes was bronze skin.
The muscles of the forearm are knotted, and apart from a white mark, the skin is not even broken!
Ye Jingtang's eyes were stunned, and for a moment he thought he was being deceived.
The two sides were fighting, and there was obviously no chance for communication.
The tall figure blocked the long knife with his right arm, and punched out with his left hand, hitting Ye Jingtang directly in the chest.
This punch was quite heavy, but Ye Jingtang didn't know any good moves, and his foundation was solidified by his adoptive father.
To put it simply, the attack power is not good, but the ability to withstand hits is flawless.
After being punched in the chest, Ye Jingtang didn't react at all. He inserted the blade into the ground, slid back a few steps, and stabilized his body.
But as soon as he stopped, a gust of wind blew from the front, lifting the hair beside his ears.
Ye Jingtang felt a chill in his heart and immediately leaned back to avoid it.
The next moment, a ghostly figure passed by from above. It looked like a coir raincoat blown by the wind, without any entity.
But a lunar face actually appeared under the bamboo hat, looking at him coldly, his body moving with the wind, as if he didn't have a single bone.
Ye Jingtang swung his knife at the ghost figure, but found that the blade touched the coir raincoat, and the coir raincoat moved away with the knife without any sense of force.
The knife swept through without hurting Guiying at all. Instead, his right arm was rubbed.
The force of the 'ghost pat on the shoulder' was so light that Ye Jingtang felt like he was being scratched by his robe.
But immediately his shoulders became sore and numb, coldness penetrated his body, and the strength of his right arm was greatly reduced.
Ye Jingtang was slightly shaken. He turned over and put the long sword back into its sheath. He held the handle of the sword behind his back with his left hand. With his back to the wall, his peripheral vision locked the two figures on the left and right at the same time.
The fluttering ghost figure has silently blocked the only exit. The bamboo hat is slightly lowered and motionless, like a piece of wood.
The same goes for tall figures.
Although he didn't move, he could feel the invisible pressure in the silent alley, as if there were two mountains standing on the left and right of the alley...
